overall_assessment: Core content, all three learning-outcome groups, and most coursework and assessment design are preserved across all 12 courses. All suspect leak flags are false alarms: references to assessment, teaching methods, literature and learning materials describe outcomes, subject matter or compulsory tasks rather than leaked sections. Unflagged defects concern mixed-purpose content blocks, one residual coursework gate in assessment, and exam administration retained in two random controls; these are localized rather than institution-wide extraction failures.

findings.evidence: Oppgaven skal ha et omfang på 10.000 – 12.000 ord.
findings.description: Heading-based assignment retains text belonging to other canonical sections in course_content. In PEL2.2 the introduction includes individual authorship, academic-integrity rules, the 10,000–12,000-word assessment length and oral presentation, but assessment lacks these design details. NOR1.2 retains the continuation of storytelling exercises in course_content, and NOR1.3 retains the explicit course methods sentence about writing exercises, speech formation and drama exercises; neither has a teaching_methods row. The rubric requires assignment by meaning, including within mixed-purpose source blocks.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Steiner uses the text fallback. Introductory and Innhold blocks are assigned wholesale to course_content; sectionize() and the subsequent cleanup do not separate these embedded teaching-method and assessment-design sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Steiner-specific sentence/block reassignment rules: move the introductory paragraph beginning FoU-oppgaven er et individuelt arbeid, and its academic-integrity rules, to assessment while excluding the delivery-date clause; move the sentences beginning Øvelser i fortellerkunst fortsetter and Estetiske arbeidsmåter i emnet er to teaching_methods. Preserve the surrounding subject-matter text in course_content.

findings.evidence:
Studenter som uten gyldig grunn ikke har lagt inn tekster innen fristene i arbeidsmappen, får ikke
levere vurderingsmappe.
findings.description: The deadline/absence rule is a condition for permission to submit the assessed portfolio, not assessment design, and belongs in coursework_requirements. The extractor correctly moves the immediately following sentence requiring approval of all working-portfolio texts, but leaves this related access condition in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The gate detection in .split_inline_coursework() / .gate_sentence_regex in R/extract_sections.R recognizes approval-based conditions but misses this negative formulation without an explicit arbeidskrav, approval or obligatory-work keyword.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend gate detection with a bounded rule matching the complete sentence beginning Studenter som uten gyldig grunn ikke har lagt inn tekster and ending får ikke levere vurderingsmappe. Move it with the adjacent approval condition into coursework_requirements; retain the portfolio selection, reflection text and exam form in assessment.

findings.evidence:
Ny/utsatt eksamen
Ved gyldig fravær eller ikke bestått resultat, kan eksamen tas opp igjen.
findings.description: The assessment row retains the resit heading and resit eligibility rule. These are exam logistics expressly excluded by course_plan_spec.md, while the preceding grade scale, passing conditions and equal weighting are valid assessment design.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In R/blocks.R the text reader only recognizes heading candidates after a blank line. Here Ny/utsatt eksamen immediately follows the weighting paragraph, so the existing .drop mapping is never applied; the stock resit cleanup also does not match this formulation.
findings.suggested_fix: In the Steiner text reader, recognize an exact standalone Ny/utsatt eksamen line as a .drop boundary even without a preceding blank line. Drop its trailing resit text while retaining the preceding equal-weighting sentence.

findings.evidence: Hvis oppgaven vurderes til karakteren F, ikke bestått, kan kandidaten levere ny oppgave til angitt frist.
findings.description: The assessment row includes examiner arrangements, recording the title and grade on the diploma, pointers to appeal/resit rules, and the rule for submitting a new assignment after failure. These administrative notices are excluded by the specification; only the actual assessment and A–F grading information belongs here.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: These notices occur as running text under Vurdering rather than separately mapped logistics headings. The .drop heading map cannot remove them, and R/extract_sections.R has no matching Steiner-specific sentence cleanup in .section_noise or the logistics cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Steiner-specific sentence cleanup for the examiner-only, diploma-recording, handbook/learning-platform appeal pointer and failed-assignment resubmission notices. For the opening sentence that combines examiner arrangements with the A–F scale, preserve the assessment subject and grading information while removing the examiner clause.
